name: Tomb of Gia Long
kicker: Pine-hill tomb of the dynasty’s founder
summary: Walk the pine hills at Gia Long’s tomb, a family complex rather than one courtyard, in Hương Thọ. An adult ticket is 150,000 VND, and a child from 7 to 12 is free. It is not on the four-site ticket. The boat is about 18 km and the road about 16 km. Minutes on site are check on arrival.
getThere: About 18 km by boat, or about 16 km by road, then a ferry. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: A yellow pavilion among the pines at Gia Long’s tomb

notice.title: Not on the four-site ticket
notice.body: The 530,000 VND adult ticket covers the Imperial City, Minh Mang, Tu Duc, and Khai Dinh. Gia Long is a separate 150,000 VND adult ticket. A child from 7 to 12 is free here, not the 30,000 VND child line used at those three tombs.

body: The name covers a family of tombs, not one courtyard. Work ran from 1814 to 1820, after Empress Thừa Thiên Cao died. The centre describes more than 28 square kilometres and 42 named hills, from the Trường Sơn foothills to the Tả Trạch. The address field says xã Hương Thọ, huyện Hương Trà. The same record’s description says xã Hương Thọ, thành phố Huế. Both stay.

Three zones make the visit. The burial of the king and the empress has an honor court, seven terraces, and Bửu Thành with two stone tombs. Minh Thành temple is on the right. A stele pavilion on the left carries Minh Mạng’s “Thánh đức thần công”. There is no outer wall. The pines are the boundary. The centre says 85 marker columns once stood, 42 remained in 1859, and two are left.

An adult ticket is 150,000 VND. A child from 7 to 12 pays nothing. Under 7 is free. Hue residents and the other groups named in Resolution 55 pay half. The centre’s own approach is a boat of about 18 km on the Perfume River to the landing, or a road of about 16 km, then the Kim Ngọc ferry and a few kilometres of forest track to those two columns. How long to stay is check on arrival.

figures.caption: Two stone tombs in the burial court
figures.alt: Two stone tombs side by side among trees at the tomb of Gia Long

gettingThere: From the south bank, the centre’s own route is a boat of about 18 km up the Perfume River, or a road of about 16 km and then the Kim Ngọc ferry, plus a few kilometres of forest track. The minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the south bank
legs.body: Boat about 18 km, or road about 16 km and the Kim Ngọc ferry. No published minute count. Check on arrival.
